### Atmos Energy Corporation to Host Fiscal 2026 Year End Earnings Conference Call on November 5, 2026


October 6, 2026


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Atmos Energy Corporation (NYSE: ATO) will host a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 10 a.m. Eastern to review the company’s Fiscal 2026 financial results, establish guidance for Fiscal 2027, and refresh the company’s five-year plan through Fiscal 2031. Atmos Energy will release these results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, following the market close.


To listen to the conference call, please dial either the toll-free or international number provided below. You may also listen to the call on the Atmos Energy website at[www.atmosenergy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.atmosenergy.com&esheet=54617321&newsitemid=20261006651668&lan=en-US&anchor=www.atmosenergy.com&index=1&md5=857cba9e2c30e3f1b17a75f136fe0292) . The Internet broadcast will be archived for 30 days.


**Conference Call Details**


**November 5, 2026**


**10 a.m. Eastern / 9 a.m. Central**


**U.S. Toll-free: +1 833-461-5787**


**International: +1 585-542-9983**


**Meeting ID: 232 888 973**


**Internet webcast:**[www.atmosenergy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F232888973&esheet=54617321&newsitemid=20261006651668&lan=en-US&anchor=www.atmosenergy.com&index=2&md5=9aa41c8ca821378cd86a6fdf1ca66777)


Atmos Energy Corporation, a natural gas-only distributor, is an S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas. We safely deliver reliable, efficient, and abundant natural gas to approximately 3.4 million distribution customers i8n over 1,400 communities across eight states located primarily in the South. As part of our vision to be the safest provider of natural gas services, we are modernizing our business and infrastructure while continuing to invest in safety, innovation, environmental sustainability, and our communities. Atmos Energy manages proprietary pipeline and storage assets, including one of the largest intrastate natural gas pipeline systems in Texas.
